category: inference API on the Gonka network, one-time 100M-token grant, anonymous account

free_tier.stated: a one-time gift of 100 million tokens to the account pool at signup, with no monthly reset; a new key holds 0 tokens until tokens are allocated from the pool
free_tier.notes: creating extra keys does not grant more free tokens; paid top-ups are about $0.02 per 1M tokens

tooling: OpenAI-compatible client at https://inference.dahl.global/v1 with a Bearer key; sign-up is browser-only behind a Cloudflare check
chaining: top-up with crypto (USDT, BTC and others via NOWPayments) makes the account paid and first in the capacity queue

limits.value: 100 million tokens once per account, spent on input plus output tokens
parallel-request limits per key and per account and a per-model concurrency cap return 429; free accounts queue behind paid ones at peak; no numbers published

binding_note: the one-time 100M-token grant is the whole free allowance

identity_cost.detail: an account is a username and a generated fingerprint that is the password; there is no email recovery by design; sign-up runs a Cloudflare browser check

reliability_note: at model capacity, requests are admitted paid accounts first, then free accounts; 429 model_concurrency when a model is full

evidence.quote: - New account: 100 million tokens as a gift at signup — they go to the pool, not to the first key.
evidence.proved: a new account receives 100 million tokens at signup

evidence.quote: Creating extra keys does not grant more free tokens.
evidence.proved: extra keys add no free tokens

evidence.quote: If you lose the fingerprint, create a new account. There is no email recovery by design.

evidence.proved: the account is a username plus a fingerprint

evidence.quote: When a model is at capacity, requests are admitted by account class: paid accounts first, then free accounts, then keys not linked to an account.
evidence.proved: free accounts queue behind paid at capacity
